newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land hits record high at HK$63.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land hits record high at HK$63.

text.p: Shares of Henderson Land Development Co Ltd hit a record high on Friday, rising HK$1.25, or 2.02 percent, to HK$63.00, boosted by the company's high dividend payout, brokers said.
"A high dividend payout of a total HK$2.43 per share attracted investors, especially since the company's fundamentals are strong," said one sales manager at regional brokerage.
Henderson Land, which reported higher-than-expected yearly earnings growth earlier this week, proposed a final dividend of HK$1.43 and a special cash bonus of HK$1.0 per share.
